shared_or_similar_visual_information: Fractional and decimal notations for one real number: 1/5 and 0.2.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The radius length has numerical value 1/5, in cm. Right image: The marked point has x-coordinate 0.2.
Rationales: 1/5=0.2, but one value labels a radius length and the other an x-coordinate; their local mathematical roles differ.
